title: Platform code registry
description: Language-neutral registry of permanent warning and refusal codes across every API surface. See schemas/registry/README.md for field semantics, the addition rule, and the endpoint/door/channel vocabulary.

format_version.description: The registry format's own version. Pinned to the version this schema validates; a registry claiming a different format_version must validate against that version's own schema instead.

code.description: The unique, lower-snake-case code spelling. Permanent once published: a changed meaning gets a new code, never a rewritten definition under the same spelling.

classification.description: refusal is a request that cannot be answered. It appears in a non-2xx problem-details body, a 200 no_data reason, a 200 unsupported reason, or a 200 no_data response's flagged_match.gate. warning is a diagnostic attached to an otherwise-answered request. It appears in diagnostics.warnings, the SSE stream's terminal done event, a Datasets manifest's warnings array, a Datasets options envelope's warnings array, or a Skills API list or skill body's warnings array.

definition.description: The stable semantic definition: one to three sentences, present tense, no implementation detail (no function or variable names).

owning_contract.description: The short name of the normative contract document that defines this code's meaning.

owner.description: The team accountable for this code's meaning.

introduced_in.description: The owning contract's version that first defined this code.

mappings.description: Every endpoint/door/channel combination this code is allowed to appear on.

lifecycle.description: active: in current use. retired: no longer emitted, spelling permanently reserved and never reused for a different meaning. A published entry may otherwise not be deleted; the one exception is a narrow, explicitly named allowance in tools/validate_registry.py for a code whose producing engine was removed before it was ever actually emitted.

endpoint.description: The contract endpoint this code can appear on.

doors.description: The request doors this mapping applies to. Omitted when the code applies regardless of door.

channel.description: problem_details is a non-2xx RFC 9457 body. no_data_reason is the 200 no_data status's `reason`. unsupported_code is the 200 unsupported status's `code`. diagnostics_warning is an entry in the response envelope's diagnostics.warnings. done_event_warning is an entry in the SSE stream's terminal done event, for trailing work that finishes after the response event has shipped. manifest_warning is an entry in a Datasets manifest's warnings array or a Datasets options envelope's warnings array. flagged_match_gate is the failed quality-gate code in a 200 no_data response's `flagged_match.gate`, naming why the nearest real match was flagged in place of a confident answer. skills_warning is an entry in a Skills API list body's or skill body's warnings array. observations_omission_reason is a returned Spec's `observations.omitted.reason`, the 200 response's own explanation for why that Spec's observations preview carries no series. The Datasets observations body carries the same `omitted` object.

http_status.description: The non-2xx HTTP status. Present only when channel is problem_details.
